business_problem: Mosaic AI, an Enterprise AI platform, unifies a company's fragmented knowledge and tech stack onto a single platform where companies can build AI Assistants, workflows, and analytics that boost employee output and drive consistently high quality experiences for customers.
solution_summary: Mosaic AI leverages Google Cloud solutions and models, including Vertex AI and Gemini. Google Cloud provides an advanced, reliable infrastructure for Mosaic AI's complex backend operations and data needs. offers a generative AI platform designed to enhance customer self-service and employee efficiency. The platform integrates with 100+ enterprise systems. Once integrated, companies can build AI assistants on top of their data to power a wide range of workflows and use-cases across customer support, customer success, product, R&D, and sales. Building on Google Cloud's infrastructure and models like Gemini, Mosaic AI dramatically consolidates the tech stack, allowing businesses to make the most of their company knowledge and customer-facing response, implementing data-driven decisions in essential applications, using a single source of truth.
